top_priorities.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) defense-in-depth header
top_priorities.evidence_summary: Response headers do not include Content-Security-Policy.

evidence.observation: Response headers do not include Content-Security-Policy.
evidence.negative_evidence: Informational hardening observation; does not constitute an exploitable vulnerability by itself.

verification.result: Evaluated server HTTP response headers; missing-csp defense-in-depth header was not present.

top_priorities.remediation: Deploy a robust Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header restricting script execution, styles, and object embeds to trusted sources. Begin with `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only` during staging.

top_priorities.title: Missing HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header on HTTPS endpoint
top_priorities.description: Missing HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header on HTTPS endpoint
top_priorities.evidence_summary: HTTPS response headers do not include Strict-Transport-Security.

evidence.observation: HTTPS response headers do not include Strict-Transport-Security.
evidence.negative_evidence: Endpoint is served over HTTPS but does not mandate persistent transport security.

verification.result: Evaluated server HTTP response headers; missing-hsts defense-in-depth header was not present.

top_priorities.remediation: Enable HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) with a directive such as `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload` on all HTTPS responses.

top_priorities.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header (browser feature gating)
top_priorities.evidence_summary: Response headers do not include Permissions-Policy.

evidence.observation: Response headers do not include Permissions-Policy.
evidence.negative_evidence: Browser feature delegation policy not explicitly configured.

verification.result: Evaluated server HTTP response headers; missing-permissions-policy defense-in-depth header was not present.

top_priorities.remediation: Configure a `Permissions-Policy` header explicitly disabling unnecessary browser capabilities (e.g. `camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()`).

top_priorities.title: Missing Referrer-Policy defense-in-depth header
top_priorities.evidence_summary: Response headers do not include Referrer-Policy (browser default applies).

evidence.observation: Response headers do not include Referrer-Policy (browser default applies).
evidence.negative_evidence: Referrer policy is not explicitly declared; browser fallback applies.

verification.result: Evaluated server HTTP response headers; missing-referrer-policy defense-in-depth header was not present.

top_priorities.remediation: Review the observed endpoint and asset configurations, adhere to principle of least privilege, and restrict unauthorized access.

top_priorities.title: Missing or incomplete X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header
top_priorities.description: Missing or incomplete X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header

evidence.negative_evidence: MIME sniffing protection not explicitly declared.

verification.result: Evaluated server HTTP response headers; missing-x-content-type-options defense-in-depth header was not present.

top_priorities.remediation: Add `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` header across all responses to prevent browser MIME-type sniffing.
